evidence_text:
Comparison brief: Almadine Broker vs Kestrelq Broker
evidence_dose=4 (positive ⇒ more points favour Almadine Broker)

- p1: sustained throughput (msg/s): Almadine Broker=410000 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=285000
- p2: end-to-end p99 (ms): Almadine Broker=14 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=23
- p3: broker memory per partition (MB): Almadine Broker=6.2 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=9.8
- p4: cluster licence cost ($/mo): Almadine Broker=1800 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=2450
- p5: rebalance duration (s): Almadine Broker=8 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=19
- p6: exactly-once overhead (%): Almadine Broker=7 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=14
- p7: max retained topics: Almadine Broker=50000 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=32000
- p8: cold-start recovery (min): Almadine Broker=2.5 ← better | Kestrelq Broker=6.0

Tally: Almadine Broker better on 8/8; Kestrelq Broker better on 0/8.
